facts.value: Helios Industrial
Invoice register is the source of truth for what is owed; bank statement contains unrelated operating items that must not be treated as customer receipts.
Pair invoice rows to bank receipts on customer name / payer name using semantic normalization; do not fail a match solely on spelling.
Do not use amount as a match key. Short payments and overpayments must still pair so Finance can see the variance.
Allow the lesser of 1% of the invoice total or USD 50.00 variance.
abs(actual − expected) > min(0.01 × expected, 50.00)
A second payment of the same invoice amount is a duplicate and must be flagged.
Invoices with no bank receipt that are past due more than 30 calendar days escalate for collections.
Excel workbook with a sheet per outcome: matched (paid), residuals (partial / split leftovers), exceptions (unpaid, duplicate, out-of-tolerance). Download only — no Slack.
